name: agent-roles
description: Role skills for multi-agent setups where several agent tabs share a machine, a checkout, a message bus, and a decision inbox

tracker.title: Issue tracker
tracker.description: Where tickets are filed: github or jira.

tracker_project.title: Tracker project
tracker_project.description: The GitHub repository (owner/name) or Jira project key that tickets go to. Leave empty to be asked.

pipeline.title: Implementation pipeline
pipeline.description: How work is handed off for implementation, for example a work-queue command or a coordinator's message-bus name. Leave empty to be asked.

max_requeues.title: Maximum requeues
max_requeues.description: How many times pr-merger may requeue one ejected pull request, each after a root-cause analysis.

outbox.title: Outbox name
outbox.description: The approval-gated outbox that messaging-manager sends outgoing chat messages through. Leave empty to be asked.
